google/gemini-2.5-flash.mistake: The natural language statement "For all humans, if they either handle pressure well or remain calm, then they can perform under stress." uses 'either...or' which typically implies inclusive OR when not followed by "but not both". The FOL statement uses the exclusive OR operator (⊕), which means only one of the conditions can be true. If a human both handles pressure well AND remains calm, the natural language condition would be met, but the FOL condition would be false, leading to a mismatch. Thus, a simple inclusive OR (∨) should have been used instead of XOR (⊕) in the antecedent.
